d: Field of battle illuminated at night. Royal Pavilion where is wounded Troncone, leaning on grand'asta. Troncone, Cino, Sivenio.
Zidiana coming out of her pavilion crying, then Egaro.
Teuzzone, Zidiana, Cino, Sivenio, Egaro. Chinese people and soldiers from the city with royal insignia, warrior remains, stretching out, umbrella.
Amphitheatre prepared for the declaration of the new emperor, with royal throne, People spectator and seats. Zidiana, Teuzzone, Cino, Sivenio and Egaro. People and Soldiers.
Teuzzone, Egarus with Warriors, and above.
Zidiana, Hegarus; then Teuzzone, and Zelinda hidden.
Wood adjacent to the imperial palace. Zelinda, then Cino.
Cloudy with plow in the middle, prepared for the sacrifice. Zidiana, Cino, Sivenio, Hegarus, Peoples; all crowned with flowers.
Teuzzone between the Guards, and said so.
Cloudy disappears, and majestic palace appears. Argonte with more Warriors.
